title: Cross-signal Latency Explorer for Model Routes (streaming vs non-streaming)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a consolidated dashboard and exploratory UI that correlates latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) across model + route dimensions, and splits traffic by streaming vs non-streaming pathways. The dashboard should join traces, metrics, and logs so engineers can quickly identify whether high tail latency is isolated to specific model variants, routing rules, or streaming codepaths (gRPC/HTTP2 streaming). This ticket covers schema changes, a set of queries for the dashboard, UI panel prototypes, and a rollout plan with canary checks.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 latency by (model, route) for both streaming and non-streaming traffic across selectable time windows (1h/6h/24h/7d)
Tracing hook correlation shows the top 5 trace spans contributing to tail latency for a selected (model, route, streaming-mode)
Query performance must return results < 2s for 24h time window on the staging telemetry cluster
Panels include timezone-aware comparisons and a per-route error-rate overlay (5xx/timeout), and can be embedded into runbooks
Automated canary alerts fire when p95 breach or error rate spike exceeds configured thresholds for production routes
design_notes: Prefer a single source-of-truth metrics table that tags each request with model_id, route_id, streaming:boolean, and trace_id to allow efficient joins
Avoid duplicating cardinality by keeping model+route as a single composite tag for dashboard grouping; provide a tag-to-field mapping for filtering
UI should default to 'top N routes by throughput' to avoid noisy full-cardinality renders; provide an explicit 'show all' option
Use sampling for traces when traffic > 1k req/s and fall back to aggregated span histograms to compute contributions to tail latency
implementation_notes: Telemetry schema change: add 'streaming_mode' tag (values: 'streaming','sync') to metrics pipeline — downstream compatibility maintained via default 'sync' value
Add trace propagation header validation in router to surface missing-trace gaps as a separate counter
Create a ClickHouse materialized view (or Promscale rollup) with daily partitions by model_route_streaming to accelerate percentile queries
Instrument server-side span names for 'prefix_cache','kv_cache_lookup','model_infer','serialize_stream' to make root-cause attribution more precise
dashboard_queries:
-- example ClickHouse percentile breakdown
SELECT model_route, streaming_mode, quantileExact(0.5)(lat_ms) AS p50, quantileExact(0.95)(lat_ms) AS p95, quantileExact(0.99)(lat_ms) AS p99 FROM request_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY model_route, streaming_mode ORDER BY sum(count) DESC LIMIT 50;

-- span contribution: approximate percent of p95 attributable to span
SELECT span_name, quantileExact(0.95)(span_time_ms) AS span_p95, count() AS cnt FROM span_metrics WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM request_metrics WHERE model_route = '{selected}' AND streaming_mode = '{mode}' AND timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY span_name ORDER BY span_p95 DESC LIMIT 10;

-- error overlay by route
SELECT model_route, streaming_mode, sum(error) / sum(count) AS error_rate FROM request_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY model_route, streaming_mode ORDER BY error_rate DESC LIMIT 50;
